records.description: Track fountain pens, ink bottles, current fills, remaining amounts, corrections, cleanings, and immutable history in one private offline ledger. No account, subscription, analytics, or cloud dependency.

records.name: Vetora Scan
records.tagline: AI-powered vulnerability scanning for modern web apps
records.description: Vetora Scan uses AI to hunt down vulnerabilities in modern web apps before they become incidents. Instead of generic rule-based scanning, it understands app logic — during our own dogfooding, it caught two critical Supabase RLS flaws, including one that let anyone unlock a paid report without paying. Built for developers shipping fast with Next.js, Supabase, and AI-assisted code, where security often gets skipped under deadline pressure.

records.name: Retro Y2K Theme
records.tagline: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme
records.description: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme. Enjoy nostalgic web aesthetics, and classic UI designs! Back to 2000 has never been easier! RawY2K is the ultimate retro website modifier that transforms any modern web page into a vintage 90s and Y2K aesthetic experience. Customize your browser with custom cursors, nostalgic Windows 98 UI, and classic GeoCities style themes instantly. Relive the golden age of the internet where the web was raw, fun, and full of chaotic creativity.

records.name: Leaderboard.lol
records.tagline: The live leaderboard powered by verified crypto bids
records.description: A live crypto leaderboard for projects, creators, apps, channels, and digital services.

records.name: SIMURG
records.tagline: Hallucination detecting for AI models and free web-search.
records.description: Zero-leak online detection of LLM decoding corruption and Free Web Search for your AI agents! Catch repetition loops, language drift and garbage mid-stream, before the user sees a bad token. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API. - doofzoff/SIMURG

records.name: VerbaGPT
records.tagline: Connect any database, ask hard questions - secure and easy
records.description: VerbaGPT let's you connect any database (snowflake, azure, mysql, postgres etc) and you can ask questions in natural language. Now anyone can extract value from datasets large and small, without needing to code. It has a custom-built harness and context management layer that mitigates hallucinations and allows for fast, efficient analytics.

records.name: Decoded Person
records.tagline: Walking towards brilliance
records.description: Decoded Person delivers fast, expert coverage of AI, hardware, software, robotics, and science — with sharp analysis and timely reporting.

records.name: Smartapp.az- Smart Business Platform
records.tagline: Run your business smartly
records.description: SmartApp is a comprehensive all-in-one business management platform offering POS, real-time table & order management, inventory control, staff panels, and QR menu solutions for modern businesses.

records.name: Adowise
records.tagline: Turn your expertise into a business
records.description: Create your custom page on Adowise to sell services, digital products, courses, host webinars, and seamlessly monetize your expertise.

records.name: Callvent
records.tagline: Turn every phone call into a calendar entry
records.description: I built Callvent because every work call vanished the moment I hung up. Now a call ends, you get a notification, and one tap saves it to the calendar you already use, with contact, note, tag, and callback reminder. Works with regular calls plus WhatsApp, FaceTime, Telegram, Signal, Teams, and Zoom, and writes to iCloud, Google Calendar, Exchange, or CalDAV. Everything stays on your device: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Native for iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, and Wear OS.

records.name: Veline AI
records.tagline: AI companions that remember, evolve, and feel personal
records.description: Create your own AI girlfriend for free — no sign up, no payment. Chat, flirt, and build a real connection with a custom AI companion. Start talking instantly at Veline AI.

records.name: BACWise
records.tagline: Free blood alcohol calculator and alcohol safety toolkit
records.description: Estimate blood alcohol concentration with a medically cautious BAC calculator and explore 113 evidence-informed guides on alcohol, health, testing, medications and driving laws.

records.name: Gold Rates in Pakistan
records.tagline: Latest gold rates and updates in Pakistan
records.description: Live gold rate in Pakistan today & current gold price per tola, 10 grams & per gram in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Quetta, Peshawar & all major cities. 24K, 22K, 21K, 18K rates in PKR.

records.name: Natural Daily Glow Habits
records.tagline: Glow naturally, every single day.
records.description: nternal Hydration & Electrolytes: Combine high water intake with adequate electrolytes to improve overall skin plumpness. Consistent Sunscreen Reapplication: Daily SPF 30+ prevents up to 80% of visible premature aging; reapply every two hours when outdoors. Gentle Exfoliation Balance: Limit chemical exfoliants (AHAs/BHAs) to 2–3 times per week to avoid damaging the moisture barrier.

records.name: Social Media Downloader
records.tagline: Paste a link, save the video in its original quality
records.description: Paste a link from TikTok, X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, Threads, Snapchat, Twitch, Vimeo — or any other site — and get the file the platform serves for that public post: HD video, MP3 audio, or the images from a carousel. No account, no install, no ads, no limits. Open source, MIT.

records.name: AI Photo Studio
records.tagline: Create 4K Studio Portraits & Product Photos with AI
records.description: AI Photo Studio turns simple photos and selfies into 4K professional studio-quality portraits, corporate LinkedIn headshots, and e-commerce product photoshoots in seconds without expensive studio equipment.

records.name: UNIKT
records.tagline: Tagline The modern directory for French startups and SaaS
records.description: UNIKT référence, classe et met en avant les startups françaises. Explorez les nouveaux lancements, vUnikt is a curated directory of French startups and SaaS products. Discover emerging tools, explore what makers are building in France, or submit your own product to gain visibility and build a high-quality public profile.otez pour vos favorites et suivez les tendances par…

records.name: License for Envato
records.tagline: Envato theme & plugin license management Software
records.description: License For Envato is an Envato theme & plugin license management solution for WordPress.

records.name: WASP Multi-Drop Creative Studio
records.tagline: AI-powered creative studio
records.description: AI-powered creative studio generating 8K product visuals. We blend your campaign colors without altering your product's original geometry using proprietary AI architectures.

records.name: TapOkie Work
records.tagline: Lone worker safety without a call centre or contract
records.description: TapOkie Work is lone worker safety for small teams — without a call centre or long contract. Workers tap Start Visit on arrival and End Visit when they leave. If checkout is missed or SOS, managers get email and browser push (location when captured). Escalation notifies a backup if nobody acknowledges. Built for care visits, estate viewings, charity outreach, and field engineers. From $5/worker/month, cancel anytime, setup in minutes. 10-minute warning before alerts fire cuts false alarms.

records.name: Umfeld.App Early Beta Launch
records.tagline: Give your AI a memory for people.
records.description: Umfeld is a personal CRM built MCP-first: it turns your Google Contacts into a living relationship graph and hands it to Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client. Unlike classic personal CRMs, your AI can read and write it ask "who have I lost touch with?", log a coffee by voice, get nudges from a relationship health score before people cool off. Hosted in Germany. For friends, family and your network, no pipelines, no deals.

records.name: Online C++ Compiler
records.tagline: Simple online tools for images, PDFs and everyday files
records.description: The best online c++ compiler. Use our free c++ ide with integrated gdb cpp compiler to write, comSnapLoom brings together simple, browser-based tools for working with images, PDFs and files. From converting and compressing images to creating PDFs and handling everyday file tasks, SnapLoom focuses on making common jobs quick and easy—without complicated software or unnecessary steps. Upload your file, choose what you need, and get your result.pile, and run C++ code instantly on any device.

records.name: Eye Pressure Support
records.tagline: Eye Pressure Support W/ Mirtogenol Life Extension Pycnogenol
records.description: 👀 Taking care of your eyes has become one of my top priorities. Most of us spend hours every day looking at phones, laptops, and TV screens. I started paying more attention to my eye health after realizing how much strain my eyes go through. While looking for nutritional support, I came across Life Extension Eye Pressure Support with Mirtogenol®. What caught my attention: ✅ Contains clinically studied Mirtogenol® ✅ Includes Bilberry Extract + Pycnogenol® ✅ Vegetarian & Non-GMO ✅

records.name: quelo
records.tagline: Social Trivia Platform
records.description: Pick a topic, get matched in seconds live. 7 questions, 10 seconds each. Cricket, Math,Countries & Capital, TV shows and 140+ more. Jump into real-time quiz battles with friends or players around the world. No waiting.Just fast, competitive trivia. Real-time gameplay Play live quiz matches where every second counts. Climb the leaderboard Track your performance and improve with every match. Why Quelo? Most quiz apps feel slow and repetitive. Quelo is fast, competitive, and addictive.

records.name: GenRouter
records.tagline: Multiple AI models. One free place
records.description: GenRouter is a free AI service that brings multiple AI models into one place. Chat with different models without switching between platforms, with 150 tokens available every day. No subscriptions. No ads. Just AI.

records.name: Ready to Learn Affiliate Marketing
records.tagline: I help you build your online income skills?
records.description: Looking for a step-by-step system to help you build your online income skills? This training covers topics like: ✅ Affiliate Marketing Basics ✅ Facebook & Instagram Marketing ✅ AI Content Creation ✅ Sales Funnels ✅ Marketing Automation ✅ Traffic Strategies ✅ Bonus Resources Whether you're just getting started or want to improve your marketing skills, this course provides practical lessons you can learn at your own pace. 💲 Limited-Time Price: Only $19 Learn more here: 🔗 http://etgh.site/A5KDE

records.name: Kokoro
records.tagline: Characters Who Remember You
records.description: Chat with anime AI characters that remember you, grow with you, and speak to you. Build deep relationships across Romance, Fantasy, Supernatural, and more. Free to start.

records.name: Rawaj.live
records.tagline: Save your time, and start growing your business smarter.
records.description: Get 10 Marketing Services in One Place! • 📝 Content & Copy Generation: AI-written ads, articles, and social media posts perfectly tailored to your brand identity. • 🎨 Image & Video Creation: Automated high-resolution graphics and professional video generation. • 🤖 Auto-Publishing & Smart Auto-Reply: Complete automation for scheduling content and instantly responding to customer messages. • 📲 WhatsApp & Email Campaigns: Launch and manage direct marketing campaigns to thousands of clients at once.

records.name: AnkiPlus
records.tagline: Turn your PDF into Anki cards you can actually review
records.description: Turn textbook, lecture-note, and research-paper PDFs into review cards you can import into Anki. Choose pages and card style, confirm the page count and cost first, and let generation continue after you leave.

records.name: Scryb
records.tagline: Turn invoices & receipts into coded entries with AI
records.description: Scryb instantly converts invoices, receipts, and bank statements into fully coded accounting entries. Powered by AI, it handles any format, language, or handwriting—no templates, mapping, or manual work needed.

records.name: SpeakoFlow Mini
records.tagline: Tiny local model that fixes dictation without rewriting it
records.description: Dictation cleanup has two halves. Fix what the speaker actually got wrong, and leave everything else exactly as dictated. General models fail the second half: hand them a sentence that is already correct and they improve it. A comma becomes a full stop, a paragraph becomes bullets. SpeakoFlow Mini is 0.8B, Apache-2.0, 833 MB, and runs offline on a desktop CPU. Already-correct text comes back untouched 92.6% of the time. No API, no reasoning tokens, no rewriting.

records.name: CLII
records.tagline: A non-invasive AI terminal helper
records.description: Most tools that convert your instructions -> terminal commands are too invasive. I present CLII, an AI terminal tool that eases this friction.

records.name: DailySpawn
records.tagline: Guess the daily video game character in 6 tries
records.description: DailySpawn is a free daily guessing game for video game fans. Every day, everyone gets the same mystery video game character and has 6 attempts to guess their name. After each guess, colored tiles reveal which letters are correct, misplaced, or not in the answer. Come back every day for a new character, build your streak, track your stats, and share your results without spoiling the answer for others. No account or download required — just open DailySpawn and play.

records.name: Hey Vivia
records.tagline: Keep humans and agents on the same page
records.description: Coding agents can do a lot now. The hard part is keeping track of what they did, why they did it, and what still needs to happen. Vivia is a place where you and your agents can keep that shared context together. Tasks, decisions, notes, dependencies, and progress all stay connected, so you do not have to explain the whole project again every time. It is less about managing agents and more about helping everyone stay on the same page.

records.name: Ravioli
records.tagline: Create custom stamp shapes
records.description: Ravioli is a tiny design tool for creating custom postage-stamp shapes. Select a shape, adjust the stamp size, holes and roundness, then export your result as a transparent PNG or scalable SVG.

records.name: ChessRabbit
records.tagline: AI Chess Analysis and Game Review Platform
records.description: ChessRabbit is an AI chess analysis platform, you can: > Connect to your chesscom and lichess accounts > Analyze each game and get the explanation behind each move by ChessRabbit Agent > Ask follow up questions to know why a specific move works/doesn't work. > Get Unlimited Game Review
